identity.name: Fatih Serdar Çakmak
identity.tagline: MITRE ATT&CK is how I think about threats.

about: Computer Engineering student at Istanbul Technical University (class of 2027). Started in Industrial Automation at Kocaeli ENKA, which turned out to be solid prep for OT/IT security. At Doğuş Teknoloji I worked across SIEM, SOAR, EDR and NDR platforms: L1 incident response, SOAR playbook writing (phishing playbooks especially), EDR alert tuning, and IT/OT segmentation. Now part-time at Fibabanka doing daily alert triage, CTI feed review and firewall log analysis in a BDDK-regulated banking environment. MITRE ATT&CK is how I think about threats.

experience.title: Cyber Security Operations (SOC) Intern
highlights: Daily alert triage and CTI feed review on live production traffic, under senior analyst supervision
Incident documentation and firewall log review; first real look at what BDDK-regulated reporting looks like in practice

experience.title: Cybersecurity and Incident Response Intern
highlights: Worked across SIEM, SOAR, EDR, and NDR platforms: log correlation, alert triage, playbook writing, false-positive filtering across enterprise infrastructure
Wrote and iterated SOAR playbooks for recurring threats (phishing especially); tuned EDR alert rules to cut detection noise across enterprise infrastructure
L1 incident response, root cause analysis, and SLA case reports. Got a clear picture of how a mature SOC actually tracks and closes cases.
Monitored Active Directory and Windows/Linux system logs; applied network segmentation for IT/OT boundaries

projects.name: Tamga — LLM Security Proxy
projects.summary: Reverse-proxy security layer that inspects, rate-limits, and sanitizes LLM API traffic. Built in Go for the proxy core with Python middleware for content inspection and TypeScript for the admin dashboard. Designed for self-hosted deployment in regulated environments.

projects.name: SOC Case Study: SIEM/SOAR Simulation
projects.summary: End-to-end SOC simulation mapping multi-stage attacks to MITRE ATT&CK TTPs. Built a React dashboard for real-time alert visualization, generated realistic log datasets to test SIEM correlation rules, and designed Python-based SOAR playbook flows for automated triage and enrichment.

projects.name: Database Management System (WDI Analytics)
projects.owner_note: Team project — repo owned by teammate
projects.summary: Full-stack data platform spanning 6 business domains with RBAC, parameterized SQL to prevent injection attacks, and data integrity constraints across 10,000+ records. Built with a focus on secure query patterns and audit logging.
